text: Entrepreneur Mike Repole is the majority owner of NOBULL; the same report says Tom Brady became NOBULL's second-largest shareholder after NOBULL merged with Brady's TB12 in 2024.
short: Mike Repole is the majority owner of NOBULL; Tom Brady is its second-largest shareholder.

source.name: SGB Media: Nobull Footwear Secures Private-Equity Partner at $1 Billion Valuation
source.quote: Repole, the majority owner of Nobull
source.note: The same article calls NOBULL 'the cross-training footwear brand owned by beverage entrepreneur Mike Repole and NFL QB Tom Brady' and says the 2024 TB12 merger made Brady NOBULL's second-largest shareholder after Repole. CNBC reported the original majority-stake purchase on 2023-07-20 but its page blocks scripts (403), so SGB Media is cited as the checked source.
